title: Oceanography
description: Every ten metres of sea weighs as much as the whole sky above it: at the bottom of the Challenger Deep the water presses a thousand times harder than the air. Only a hull built like a cannonball goes there and comes back. Unlocks the Pressure Hull Plate and the Bathyscaphe, and the way down to the Hadal Trench.

puzzle.goal: Under h metres of water of density ρ, the water above every square metre weighs ρgh newtons: that is the pressure it adds. Write p, the water pressure at depth h (leaving out the air above).
puzzle.name: Hydrostatic pressure
puzzle.ask: Find p in Pa at the bottom of a trench: ρ = @{ρ} kg/m³, g = @{g} m/s², h = @{h} m.
puzzle.method: A column of water of area A and height h has mass ρAh and weight ρAhg; divide by A.
